dakar-ter-phase1.searched: Opened the AfDB Early Warning System project page and its project PDF, the AFD project page and AFD project sheet PDF, the Accountability Console complaint page for RQ 2019/1, and the Seneweb 2026 report; searched for an AfDB environmental and social impact assessment summary or resettlement action plan for the TER. None publishes loan conditions.

kariobangi-north-evictions.searched: Opened the African Development Bank's 2018 loan announcement for the Nairobi Rivers Basin Sewerage Improvement Project Phase II (via allAfrica), which gives only the co-financing shares and timeline and no conditions. No AfDB appraisal or safeguard document naming Kariobangi was found.

phnom-penh-sugar-kampong-speu.searched: Opened the Inclusive Development International case page on the ANZ-backed land grab, which sets out ANZ's 2010 assessment, the 2011 loan and the 2020 settlement. No loan agreement or covenant list has been published.

wwf-cameroon-baka-ecoguards.searched: Opened the 2020 WWF Independent Panel report 'Embedding Human Rights in Nature Conservation' and searched it for conditions attached to WWF funding of Cameroon ecoguards (code of conduct, signed agreement, grievance mechanism, free prior and informed consent).

african-parks-odzala-baka.searched: Opened African Parks' 2025 response to the independent human rights investigation at Odzala-Kokoua. It describes African Parks' own updated code of conduct, human rights training and board-level grievance mechanism, and says Congolese law sets the framework for park management, but it names no condition attached to its funding or to the seconded eco-guards.

amibara-afar-grazing-lands.conditions_add: The World Bank audit names one undertaking obtained with the credit: assurances were obtained that should groundwater levels rise so as to affect the productivity of soils, the government would fund water-table control through the Awash Valley Development Authority. The audit treats the settling of about 800 Afar families on 2,000 hectares as a project component rather than a credit requirement, and says the Afar have neither been compensated nor have they been involved in the development effort.

why.safeguard: assurances were obtained that should groundwater levels rise so as to affect the productivity of soils, the government would fund water-table control

amibara-afar-grazing-lands.searched: Opened the 1991 World Bank Operations Evaluation Department performance audit of the Revised Amibara Irrigation Project (Credit 707-ET) and looked for conditions of effectiveness, credit covenants, settlement or compensation requirements and cost recovery terms. The audit does not reproduce the credit's covenants.

gujarat-medium-irrigation-oustees.conditions_add: The completion report for the second credit says the appraisal report and the legal documents required the Government of Gujarat to prepare an integrated overall rehabilitation plan, prepare detailed economic rehabilitation plans for nine priority sub-projects, keep a rehabilitation committee in each sub-project, and rehabilitate displaced persons under the guidelines in Schedule A of the appraisal report. A covenant also required water charges set to recover operation and maintenance costs plus part of capital costs, reviewed each 31 March; the report records this as not complied with, with no revision since 1984. The report refers to conditionalities for extending the credit further tied to the treatment of displaced people.

why.safeguard: required the Government of Gujarat to prepare an integrated overall rehabilitation plan
why.fees: required water charges set to recover operation and maintenance costs plus part of capital costs

gujarat-medium-irrigation-oustees.searched: Opened the World Bank completion report for the Second Gujarat Medium Irrigation Project and read its covenant summary, resettlement and rehabilitation section and water charge covenant.

ramagundam-ntpc-oustees.conditions_add: The completion report says the credit and loan became effective after the government and NTPC signed a subsidiary loan agreement, and that NTPC was to sell the project's power in bulk to the state electricity boards under bulk supply contracts satisfactory to the Bank. The government was to ensure state governments undertook to buy at least 85% of the output. The report names no resettlement or land acquisition covenant; it records 4,116 hectares acquired, 2,279 families affected and 782 families resettled in colonies.
ramagundam-ntpc-oustees.searched: Opened the 1990 World Bank Project Completion Report for the Ramagundam Thermal Power Project (Credit 874-IN, Loan 1648-IN) and read its sections on effectiveness, bulk power sales, financial covenants, land and resettlement, environment and procurement.

farakka-ntpc-oustees.conditions_add: The completion report says the loan's conditions of effectiveness were signed bulk power supply contracts between NTPC and the state electricity boards plus a subsidiary loan agreement between the government and NTPC satisfactory to the Bank, and that the effectiveness deadline was extended four times before the loan became effective on 30 August 1985. Financial covenants required NTPC's rate of return to meet 7% through financial year 1990 and 9.5% from financial year 1991 through 1995. The report says resettlement and rehabilitation was not formally addressed at appraisal, and that the Bank's rehabilitation guidelines were agreed with NTPC only in 1993 under a later loan.
farakka-ntpc-oustees.searched: Opened the 1995 World Bank Project Completion Report for the Second Farakka Thermal Power Project (Loan 2442-IN) and read its sections on effectiveness conditions, financial covenants, procurement, resettlement and rehabilitation, and environment.

ruzizi-ii-indemnities.conditions_add: The completion report says a condition of effectiveness was proof to the Bank that the land and rights in respect of land were under SINELAC's ownership and control, and that the Project Agreement required SINELAC to take all necessary steps to acquire land and rights in respect of land. The legal agreements with IDA set the average sales price of the power so as to achieve a 10% rate of return over the project's life, and the Bank said the credit closing date would not be extended unless Ruzizi II power was priced as agreed. The report says the Bank deemed the project's impact on the local population inconsequential, so it did not require a resettlement plan.

why.land: required SINELAC to take all necessary steps to acquire land and rights in respect of land
why.prices: set the average sales price of the power so as to achieve a 10% rate of return over the project's life

ruzizi-ii-indemnities.searched: Opened the full text of the 1992 World Bank Project Completion Report for the Second Ruzizi Regional Hydroelectric Power Project and read its effectiveness conditions, Project Agreement covenants, tariff requirements, procurement and resettlement sections.

gorgol-foum-gleita.conditions_add: The completion report lists the credit's conditions of effectiveness: a legal opinion and ratification by the governments, creation of the Gorgol project directorate and appointment of its director, opening of a special operating account with initial deposits by the government, and proof that the agreements with IFAD, the Islamic Development Bank, the Saudi Fund and Libya were effective and that agreements with the other co-financiers were signed. At negotiations SONADER agreed to collect water charges to recover operation and maintenance costs, set at 12,000 ouguiya per hectare a year; none were collected in the first full cultivation year. The report records no displacement or compensation terms in the credit documents, and says a protocol was drawn up between the government and traditional land owners on use of the land to be irrigated.

why.fees: SONADER agreed to collect water charges to recover operation and maintenance costs, set at 12,000 ouguiya per hectare a year

gorgol-foum-gleita.searched: Opened the 1988 World Bank Project Completion Report for the Gorgol Noir Irrigation Project (Credit 1068-MAU) and read its effectiveness conditions, covenant compliance, land and settlement, cost recovery and procurement sections.

kiambere-dam-resettlement.conditions_add: The Bank audit says the conditions of effectiveness were the signing of the government-TARDA loan agreement and the KPLC-TARDA lease agreement, under which KPLC was to pay TARDA debt service plus a development surcharge equal to 15% of total cost and to bear all operating costs. A covenant required the power sector to earn 8% on average net revalued fixed assets, lowered retroactively to 6% for 1985. The major share of the works was limited to firms from the co-financing countries. The audit says neither the project description nor the loan covenants anticipated resettlement.

why.tied: The major share of the works was limited to firms from the co-financing countries
why.repay: KPLC was to pay TARDA debt service plus a development surcharge equal to 15% of total cost

kiambere-dam-resettlement.searched: Opened the 1995 World Bank Operations Evaluation Department performance audit of the Kiambere Hydroelectric Project (Loan 2359-KE) and read its effectiveness conditions, lease agreement, financial and tariff covenants, procurement rules, environment and resettlement sections.

nangbeto-dam-resettlement.conditions_add: A side letter to the Development Credit Agreement dated 24 July 1984 is the only legal undertaking the review names: the government and the utility CEB agreed to continue detailed work on resettlement for at least three years after reservoir filling. The review says nothing was done under it. It also says the Bank stipulated that an adequate plan be prepared in time but does not say which document contained that stipulation, and that the appraisal report, not a legal agreement, set 31 December 1985 for a more detailed plan, which CEB met.

why.safeguard: the government and the utility CEB agreed to continue detailed work on resettlement for at least three years after reservoir filling

nangbeto-dam-resettlement.searched: Opened the 1998 World Bank Operations Evaluation Department study 'Recent Experience with Involuntary Resettlement: Togo - Nangbeto' and looked for conditions of effectiveness, credit covenants and resettlement plan requirements in the legal agreements.

indonesia-regional-cities-transport.conditions_add: The completion report says cities were requested to appoint selected key staff as a condition of loan effectiveness. The loan agreement required an action plan, based on a review of urban transport planning and service arrangements, to be prepared and implemented, and required the cities to update five-year urban transport investment plans; the report records both as only partly complied with. It says land acquisition and resettlement were discussed at appraisal and confirmed during negotiations, that no special resettlement plan was prepared and no baseline surveys were conducted, and that families without title received much less than those with full title.
indonesia-regional-cities-transport.searched: Opened the 1995 World Bank Project Completion Report for the Indonesia Regional Cities Urban Transport Project and read its effectiveness conditions, covenant compliance, land acquisition and resettlement, and procurement sections.

uganda-forestry-kibale-evictions.conditions_add: The Bank audit says the Development Credit Agreement contained only the customary clause that the borrower would provide sufficient operating funds, which the audit calls inadequate. The audit says the project did not require a resettlement plan, and quotes an August 1986 Bank telex saying the Bank must assume nobody will be evicted as a result of our project; it adds that Bank policy made resettlement planning mandatory and that an encroachment study included in the project was never completed.
uganda-forestry-kibale-evictions.searched: Opened the full text of the 1997 World Bank Operations Evaluation Department performance audit of the Uganda Forestry Rehabilitation Project (Credit 1824-UG) and read its covenant, royalty, eviction and resettlement sections.

jabotabek-urban-compensation.conditions_add: The completion report's covenant table says the borrower had to carry out land acquisition and resettlement under a plan and implementation schedule satisfactory to the Bank, and records that no such plan was ever prepared or agreed, so the covenant was not complied with. Other covenants required Jakarta to prepare and implement a revenue improvement plan raising local tax revenue by at least 6% a year in real terms, to raise property tax revenue by at least 13% a year in real terms with the national tax directorate, and to keep its development grants and urban infrastructure budget allocations from exceeding 1988/89 levels in nominal terms. The report notes that later projects made satisfactory resettlement planning a condition of disbursement, but this loan did not.

why.safeguard: carry out land acquisition and resettlement under a plan and implementation schedule satisfactory to the Bank
why.tax: raising local tax revenue by at least 6% a year in real terms
why.cuts: keep its development grants and urban infrastructure budget allocations from exceeding 1988/89 levels in nominal terms

jabotabek-urban-compensation.searched: Opened the 1997 World Bank completion report for the Jabotabek Urban Development Project and read its covenant table (resettlement, revenue, budget and audit covenants) and its note on disbursement conditions in later projects.

kulekhani-hydro-resettlement.conditions_add: The Bank audit says tariff increases were a condition of the credit's effectiveness, and lists the credit covenants: raise tariffs so the Nepal Electricity Corporation earned a 4% rate of return in 1977/78 rising to 6% by 1980/81, consult IDA on any change to the organisation of the power subsector, transfer certain small existing hydro plants to the corporation, and finalize a resettlement plan for affected persons in consultation with IDA. At negotiations the government agreed to discontinue a royalty tax of about 0.08 US cents per kWh. The audit says the borrower did not implement the tariff schedule and the rate-of-return covenant was not met.

why.prices: raise tariffs so the Nepal Electricity Corporation earned a 4% rate of return in 1977/78 rising to 6% by 1980/81
why.safeguard: finalize a resettlement plan for affected persons in consultation with IDA
why.tax: the government agreed to discontinue a royalty tax of about 0.08 US cents per kWh

kulekhani-hydro-resettlement.searched: Opened the full text of the 1986 World Bank Operations Evaluation Department performance audit of the Kulekhani Hydroelectric Project (Credit 600-NEP) and read its effectiveness conditions, covenant list, tariff section, resettlement covenant and procurement rules.

antananarivo-plain-enterprises.conditions_add: The Bank audit says the credit agreement set a timeline for creating the agency to manage the flood control works, and that the agency was not created until about five years after Board approval, later than the agreement's timeline. The audit does not say a resettlement plan was required; it says land acquisition for the drainage works and the resettlement of affected people caused early implementation delays.
antananarivo-plain-enterprises.searched: Opened the full text of the 2001 World Bank Operations Evaluation Department performance audit of the Antananarivo Plain Development Project (Credit 2117-MAG) and looked for conditions of effectiveness, covenants, resettlement requirements and cost recovery terms.

freetown-red-zone-demolitions.conditions_add: The completion report says the appraisal document contained a Safeguards Action Plan setting out which safeguard instruments had to be prepared and when, that an Abbreviated Resettlement Action Plan covered the bridge, water and drainage works under components 1.2 and 1.3, and that contractors had to adopt a project-wide action plan on gender-based violence and violence against children as part of their environmental and social management plan. After the Red Zone evacuation and demolitions, which the government carried out with its own resources, the Bank determined that its involuntary resettlement policy OP 4.12 applied, and the government then agreed to conduct a social audit and submit a retroactive Resettlement Action Plan to fill the gaps; the Bank approved it in April 2019. The social audit found that some tenants and caretakers had been left out of compensation payouts and some homeowners underpaid.

why.safeguard: the appraisal document contained a Safeguards Action Plan setting out which safeguard instruments had to be prepared and when

freetown-red-zone-demolitions.searched: Opened the 2021 World Bank Implementation Completion and Results Report for the Freetown Emergency Recovery Project (P166075) and read its safeguards section, the Red Zone resettlement account and its restructuring and disbursement data.

xayaburi-dam-thai-banks.searched: Opened the BankTrack Dodgy Deal profile for the Xayaburi dam and looked for loan conditions, Equator Principles application, environmental impact assessment requirements, resettlement requirements and the EGAT power purchase agreement as repayment security.

theun-hinboun-expansion.searched: Opened the BankTrack Dodgy Deal profile for the Theun-Hinboun dam expansion and the Statkraft 2011 news page on doubling power production in Laos; looked for loan conditions, Equator Principles or IFC Performance Standards requirements, a required resettlement or livelihood plan and any lender compensation requirement.

rapu-rapu-cyanide-spills-2005.searched: Opened the BankTrack Dodgy Deal profile for the Rapu Rapu copper mine and the 'Fool's Gold' report commissioned for Greenpeace Southeast Asia, including its section on Lafayette's financial vulnerability; looked for loan conditions, hedging or completion requirements, security and environmental covenants.

santo-antonio-dam-madeira.conditions_add: No conditions attached to Santander's own lending have been published; BankTrack records only that the project has been identified as an Equator Project. Renewable Energy World reports that BNDES approved 6.1 billion reais (US$2.5 billion) for Santo Antonio Energia, 46.6% of the project cost, and set requirements that will enable utility companies to provide affordable rates to consumers. The same report says the project includes social investments of 50 million reais (US$20.9 million), as suggested by BNDES.

sources_add.title: Brazil bank funds construction of 3,150-MW Santo Antonio

santo-antonio-dam-madeira.searched: Opened the BankTrack Dodgy Deal profile for the Rio Madeira dams and the Renewable Energy World report on the BNDES loan; searched in Portuguese for the BNDES financing contract terms for Santo Antonio (conditions, national content). No Santander loan terms are published.

smb-boke-bauxite.searched: Opened Inclusive Development International's 'Unjust Enrichment: How the IFC Profits from Land Grabbing in Africa' and looked for the conditions of the IFC loan to ICICI Bank (environmental and social management system, exclusion list, Performance Standards, reporting) and for lender requirements on SMB, Winning and China Hongqiao.

kaltim-prima-coal-dayak-basap.conditions_add: Inclusive Development International says the IFC's US$186 million equity investment in Raiffeisen Bank International was done with the condition that it be down-streamed to the bank's subsidiaries in Russia, Bosnia, Kosovo and Poland, and was recorded as a capital increase in each of them. It says the IFC contended that Axis Bank had to use the US$100 million of bond proceeds only for on-lending to projects within India, and that the IFC provided no evidence of this, while the bond offering circular says only that proceeds shall be used for enhancing long term resources for funding infrastructure and affordable housing. The report says Raiffeisen's 2016 coal policy was based on IFC's recommendation, not a condition of the investment.
kaltim-prima-coal-dayak-basap.searched: Opened Inclusive Development International's 'Digging Deeper' report and looked for the conditions of the IFC's investments in Raiffeisen Bank International and Axis Bank (environmental and social management system, exclusion list, Performance Standards, coal restrictions, reporting).
